## The problem

F-399 named the seam verbatim: `BaseLayout` rendered `<Citation>` on
every page but never passed a release, so every site page kept the
legacy "Belief-pinned permalink (reproducible after SIG corrects
itself)" query-string URL — while the static origin ignores the
selector parameters (F-07/F-099/F-390) and the only selector resolver
was an offline CLI. The block promised reproducibility over a link
that could not honour it, and the print dossier lacked the
cite/licence line entirely (F-101).

## What landed

- **`web/src/lib/citation.ts`** — the block's render model:
  `citationBlock(input & { release })` returns `{mode, citeSentence,
  citeUrl, releaseId, reproducible, interimSentence}`. `release` is
  **required** (`undefined` throws — the F-399 shape is a loud
  failure; an explicit `null` is the honest fixtures/development
  state, never a fabricated one). `isImmutableReleasePath` is the
  render rule's predicate — only a `/s/<pub>/` or `/r/<pub>/`
  `p-<64hex>`-namespaced path is immutable; `REPRODUCIBLE_PHRASE` and
  `interimCitationSentence` carry the J3 §8.2 wording verbatim;
  `publicationShort` matches the release stamp's abbreviation slice.
- **`web/src/components/Citation.astro`** — renders the model: the
  verbatim cite sentence `Cite: <title>, SIG release <pub-short>
  (data as of <as_of_world>, belief <as_of_belief>, ruleset <r>)`,
  plus `, <snapshot URL>` **and** the reproducibility phrase only in
  immutable mode; the interim sentence verbatim in interim mode; the
  release id beside the as-of pair (DR-C3-14); the legacy
  selector URL labelled historical, never an immutable citation. Zero
  JavaScript.
- **`web/src/layouts/BaseLayout.astro`** — passes
  `release={publicationId, label, recordPath}` on every page, derived
  from `getReleaseStamp()` (never a page-local constant). The new
  `recordPath` prop names the page's immutable copy when it backs a
  released record; the default is `withBase(path)` — so under the
  root base the page honestly renders the interim sentence, and the
  same call yields an immutable `/s/<pub>/` path with zero template
  edits when TX-13b configures the snapshot base.
- **`web/src/pages/dossier/[slug].astro`** — passes its released
  record path `withBase(r/<pub>/c/<comp>/jurisdiction/<slug>/)`, so a
  release-bound dossier cites the immutable `/r/<pub>/` URL.
- **`web/src/pages/dossier/[slug]/print.astro`** (F-101) — the print
  footer's cite line renders the SAME `citationBlock` contract
  (sentence + conditional wording + `Licence: CC-BY-4.0`), not a
  second block; `DOSSIER_LICENCE_ID` in `dossier.ts` is the one
  licence constant the JSON twin and the print page share.
- **`web/tests/unit/citation.test.ts`** — +9 tests: missing release
  context throws; `null` is the unreleased state; the interim
  sentence is verbatim J3 §8.2; `/r/` and `/s/` paths flip to the
  immutable wording; the phrase never appears over a mutable URL
  (nine mutable/half-formed shapes); the `withBase()` chain makes a
  `/s/<pub>/` base render the page's own path immutable;
  `publicationShort` matches the stamp's slice.

## Out of scope (named owners)

The `/s/<pub>/` snapshot build, `selectors.conf` edge machinery,
withdrawal index, the legacy `withBase()` sweep, Astro `base`
configuration — P36.66a/b (rows 409/410, TX-13b). Release
identity/labels — P35.13 (dep: this row cites the id, never invents
one). The print stylesheet/dossier content — the dossier rows. Any
production republish — ships under the next republish row's
authority.
